proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spellLifecycleOverride
proposed_widenings.justification: The item grants access to an existing spell, but only with item-specific upkeep semantics: the granted Detect Thoughts instance does not require concentration and instead persists only while a separately granted Scrying instance remains active. The current surface can override DC and targeting, but it cannot override a granted spell's concentration requirement or tie its lifetime to another ongoing spell.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You don't need to concentrate on this Detect Thoughts spell to maintain it during its duration, but it ends if the Scrying spell ends."

notes: MagicItemRecord + passive/composite mechanics fit the item overall, and grant_spell_access already covers fixed DC and spell-sensor targeting. I did not author content files because encoding Detect Thoughts without the missing lifecycle override would falsely imply normal concentration and independent duration.
